newsitem.title: USA: WellCare to eliminate classes of directors.
newsitem.headline: WellCare to eliminate classes of directors.

text.p: WellCare Management Group Inc said Wednesday its board has approved an amendment to the company's charter to eliminate the classification of directors.
Currently, the company's board has three classes of directors, with directors of each class elected for three-year terms and with terms expiring in consecutive years.
The amemdment is subject to shareholder approval at the company's annual meeting scheduled for June 10, the company said.
If the shareholders approve the amendment, WellCare said it will nominate eight individuals for election as directors to serve a one-year term.
Ullman, the company's former chief executive officer, had resigned from the board on April 17, while Eileen Wilson will not stand for reelection, it said.
Another director, Mary Corsones, has also resigned from the board as part of a transition to become senior adviser for strategic planning, from chief financial officer, the company said.
Joseph Papa, the company's president and chief operating officer, has been named a director, replacing G. William Strein, who will continue to be director of WellCare subsidiaries, it said.
